description: What a parent usually asks before installing: ads, the grown-up gate, accounts, which data leaves the device, analytics, device permissions, AI usage, contact with others and physical safety. Each statement says which platforms it covers and lists the repo files it was verified against; a not_claimed list says what is deliberately not promised. Read-only; takes no input.
